entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: An information element that may be included in WB-S1 mode when both UE and network support RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: An information element that shall not be included if the UE radio capability ID IE is included.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode with RACS support
entities.description: Condition where both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

entities.name: Exclusion of UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: Property stating that if the UE radio capability ID IE is included, the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE shall not be included.

relations.description: The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS and network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID.
Inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE establishes the property that UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE shall not be included.
